species: These structures reveal that Arx1 and the eukaryote-specific rRNA expansion segment ES27 form a joint docking platform that positions Drg1 for efficient extraction of Rlp24 from the pre-ribosome.
disease_state: Pre-60S particles were purified via Arx1-TAP from a thermosensitive drg1-18 mutant after 1 hour of incubation at 37 °C as described previously.
sample_source: We assembled pre-60S particles, purified using tandem affinity purification (TAP)-tagged Bud20 as bait from a leptomycin B (LmB)-sensitive S. cerevisiae strain
strain: The Saccharomyces cerevisiae leptomycin sensitive (crm1T539C) mutant strain chromosomally expressing Bud20-GFP and the mCherry-tagged nuclear membrane protein Nic96 was grown to OD600 0.6 in SD medium supplemented with all amino acids.
